name: Adobe Firefly
levelNote: A single image is easy to try; a full campaign means managing models, reference frames and credits.
firstTask: Generate one product still from a reference image before trying video.
what: Adobe’s generative creative suite for images, vectors, video and audio. It includes Adobe and partner models and integrates with Creative Cloud workflows.
edge: Use it when you need to take a generated asset into a production workflow: refine it in Adobe apps, or use reference frames to steer a clip.
skip: ChatGPT or Gemini may be enough for a few concept images; Claude can help with the creative brief and shot list. Don’t buy a suite just to explore a direction.
pricing: US monthly prices: Standard $9.99 (2,000 credits/month), Pro $19.99 (4,000), Pro Plus $49.99 (10,000), Premium $199.99 (50,000). Free access has limited generations; check the current allocation. Premium features and partner models can consume credits at different rates.
reviews: G2 snapshot: 4.4/5 from 538 reviews for Adobe Firefly; not a score for any individual partner model.
example: Marco Riccetti’s Ember & Wick demo shows a candle brand, product imagery, five keyframes and a 10-second Black Friday promo animated with a partner model, plus a text-overlay variant. Source: the supplied post and screenshot.

extra.label: Also used in a customer campaign
extra.text: Adobe reports that Currys used Composition Reference and Generative Expand on its New Term campaign.

name: Runway
levelNote: A usable clip takes some practice with references, motion prompts and retries.
firstTask: Animate a single still with one camera move.
what: A multi-model creative platform for generating and editing video, animating still images, and chaining generation steps into reusable workflows.
edge: Use it when you need to compare motion models or iterate on multiple shots and reuse the process. Gemini’s video features may cover the generation step; Runway’s edge is the workflow around it.
skip: Use a video feature already included in your subscription for a one-off clip, or use an assistant to write the storyboard before paying for renders.
pricing: US Standard $15 month-to-month or $12/mo billed annually; 625 credits/month. Pro $35 monthly or $28/mo annually; 2,250 credits/month. Free: 125 one-time credits, not a monthly refill; available models and exports are limited. The API has separate usage pricing.
reviews: G2 snapshot: 4.2/5 from 173 reviews on the Runway listing, not the separate Gen-2 listing or a rating of a single current model.
example: Studio Unveil used Runway’s Gen-4.5 and Aleph in a hybrid live-action/AI global campaign for Salomon, according to Runway.

name: Higgsfield
levelNote: Presets help, but choosing a model and directing camera motion takes practice. MCP integration is a separate, more technical path.
firstTask: Try one slow push-in using an approved product image.
what: A multi-model image and video platform with Cinema Studio for camera direction and Marketing Studio for product ads.
edge: Use it when a defined camera move or lens look matters, or when you want Claude to help run a connected ad workflow rather than just write prompts.
skip: Use your existing assistant for scripts, shot lists and mood boards; if your existing video model already makes a usable shot, there’s little reason to add a subscription.
pricing: Starter was listed at $19/mo for 270 credits/month. Plus was listed at $59/mo regular monthly pricing or $30/mo billed annually, with 1,200 credits/month. Free access is for exploration; no included generation credits were listed. Promotions and model access change—check checkout.
reviews: G2 snapshot: 4.5/5 from 103 reviews for the platform, not for Cinema Studio or any one video model.
example: Alya Health, an olive oil brand, used Claude with Higgsfield MCP to produce video ads. The example shows the two tools working together, not one replacing the other.

extra.label: Feature guide
extra.text: See the difference between the template-led ad workflow and direct camera controls.

name: Canva
levelNote: Templates and editable text give you a starting point without technical setup.
firstTask: Edit a promo template with your own photo and offer text.
what: A template-first design platform with editable layouts, brand assets, a video editor, and AI for tasks such as design drafts and media editing.
edge: Use it when one creative needs to become several editable, on-brand assets across formats. ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini can help draft the copy; Canva gives the team a place to lay it out, resize it and revise it.
skip: If you only need campaign copy, a rough layout or a one-off image, start with the assistant you already have.
pricing: US Pro $18 month-to-month or $144/year; Business $25/person monthly or $250/person annually. Free plan: up to 20 Standard or Premium AI uses per month in a shared allowance. Ultra features such as AI video clip generation are not included on Free; that does not mean the free video editor is unavailable.
reviews: G2 snapshot reported by Style Factory: 4.7/5 from 8,349 reviews for Canva as a whole, not its generative video features.
example: Nearmap used Canva templates, Resize and Magic Switch to roll out a global rebrand across formats.

extra.label: AI limits
extra.text: Canva uses a shared allowance with different costs depending on the feature.

name: Photoroom
levelNote: Start with one upload and a guided edit; batch processing and the API are optional.
firstTask: Remove the background from one product photo and check the edges.
what: An AI product-photo editor for background removal, product scenes, catalog batches and short product videos from existing photos.
edge: Use it when you already have real product imagery and need consistent listing photos at volume. The batch and catalog workflow matters more here than being able to generate one striking image.
skip: Try ChatGPT or Gemini for one mockup, or any general assistant for photo direction and listing copy. Use real imagery whenever product accuracy matters.
pricing: US Pro $12.99 monthly or $7.50/mo billed annually; Max $34.99 monthly or $20.99/mo billed annually; Ultra starts at $99/mo. The Free plan has limited AI access and is for non-commercial use. Verify video and batch allowances for the plan you choose.
reviews: US Apple App Store snapshot: 4.8/5 from about 231,000 ratings for the mobile app. This is not a score for the web editor, API or paid video features.
example: Print-on-demand company Completeful integrated Photoroom’s API to automate product mockups for sellers.

name: Hermes Agent
levelNote: For a campaign workflow, expect to configure providers and tools, manage file access and review what the agent is allowed to do.
firstTask: Have it turn a brief into a local shot list before connecting video or granting wider permissions.
what: Nous Research’s open-source agent for using models, tools, files and integrations across repeatable tasks. It coordinates a creative workflow; it is not itself an image or video model.
edge: Use it when you want a self-hostable agent that can choose among configured providers, work across files and integrations, and reuse workflows. It can complement models from OpenAI, Anthropic or Google.
skip: For drafting or a one-off assisted task, start with your existing chat or agent mode. Hermes adds setup, permissions, maintenance and potentially separate provider charges.
pricing: The MIT-licensed agent is free to self-host. Model, tool and hosting costs depend on what you connect. Optional Nous Portal paid subscriptions: Plus $20/mo, Super $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo; do not assume any plan covers a separate video provider.
reviews: Trustpilot snapshot: 2.7/5 from six reviews for the Hermes Agent site. Too small to infer reliability. GitHub stars are not customer ratings.
example: Razorpay Engineering describes deploying network-isolated Hermes agents for internal workflows. That is evidence of deployment, not a general claim about productivity or security.

extra.label: Disclosure
extra.text: This directory preview was prepared with Hermes Agent. We did not run the candle video workflow or a head-to-head test.
